_derivation.note: official_fields.json is produced by build_official_fields.py (committed alongside, deterministic). METRICS come from the official Datascape metrics glossary (the Report Service API reference points to it as the full metric list); the glossary article body is committed verbatim as glossary_body.md. DIMENSIONS come from the Report Service reports endpoint Dimensions table, curated inline in the builder. The catalog id 'date' maps to the provider dimension token 'day' (source_field), mirroring meta-ads date -> date_start.
_derivation.expansion_rule: Official range rows ('conversion_1 to conversion_6', 'conversion_value_1 to conversion_value_63', 'skad_direct_conversion_1 to skad_direct_conversion_6', 'skad_direct_conversion_value_0 to skad_direct_conversion_value_63') are EXPANDED into one field per integer, matching how each id is individually valid in the metrics= query parameter.
_derivation.count_divergence: Metric total (343) vs the Supermetrics 81-metric catalog: Supermetrics curates a subset (their catalog is enrichment, never authority). 150 glossary rows are QUERY TEMPLATES parameterised by account data ({event_slug}_..., ..._{cohort_period}, subscription_{event_from}_to_{event_to}_rate_...): they are NOT emitted as catalog fields because enumerating them is non-deterministic against the account's events/cohort settings (same decision as meta-ads breakdown-value non-enumeration). 3 malformed official ids ('general revenue_events_min/est/max' -- contain a space in the official doc) are skipped and reported by the builder rather than silently corrected. The glossary lists skad_ecpi in two sections; the builder keeps the first occurrence and reports the duplicate.
_derivation.event_metrics_note: Account-specific event metrics ({event_slug}_events, {event_slug}_{cohort_period}_revenue_cohort, ...) are reachable via the official Events endpoint (https://dev.adjust.com/en/api/rs-api/events) which returns the machine-generated event slugs per account. Wiring dynamic event-metric discovery is a follow-up story (field_discovery.mode static for now).

_also._note: Committed verbatim as glossary_body.md. The help-center HTML shell is JS-rendered; the article body markdown was extracted from the page's Next.js data payload (pageProps.article.body) and IS the authoritative snapshot the builder parses.

sources._fetch: curl -sL https://docs.supermetrics.com/docs/adjust-fields.md | sed 's/datascape__//g' > server/modules/adjust/catalog_sources/supermetrics.md   # DO NOT COMMIT this file (enrichment snapshot only). The sed strips the Supermetrics-internal 'datascape__' id prefix so enrichment ids align with the official Report Service metric ids (datascape__cost -> cost).

probe.structural_note: The Report Service report endpoint takes comma-joined metrics= and dimensions= params over a date_period on the selected app (app_token__in). The probe batches up to 10 metric ids per request over a 1-day window with dimensions=day; a batch that returns an invalid_request (HTTP 400 on an unknown metric) is bisected so the exact rejected field is captured. Dimension fields probe with dimensions=day,<dim> and metrics=installs.
